title: message conversion bug
body:
> I'm releasing `4.0.30` with a fix. The error masks another error that will be available in fullStream or if you enable error message forwarding / log it: https://sdk.vercel.ai/docs/ai-sdk-ui/chatbot#error-messages> 
> > 
> Thanks! For me the issue was `Full stream error: [Error [AI_APICallError]: * GenerateContentRequest.contents[2].parts: contents.parts must not be empty.` similar to #3775. The first message worked fine, but when I sent a second message I saw the error because of empty tool messages from https://github.com/vercel/ai-chatbot/blob/c5a57fd7a84535db2e1262fc059a06f73cc85689/lib/utils.ts#L99> 
> > 
> ```ts> 
> messages  [> 
>   { role: 'user', content: 'test', toolInvocations: [] },> 
>   {> 
>     role: 'assistant',> 
>     content: "Understood. I'm ready to help with your questions.\n",> 
>     toolInvocations: []> 
>   },> 
>   { role: 'user', content: 'test' }> 
> ]> 
> coreMessages [> 
>   { role: 'user', content: 'test' },> 
>   { role: 'assistant', content: [ [Object] ] },> 
>   { role: 'tool', content: [] },> 
>   { role: 'user', content: 'test' }> 
> ]> 
> ```> 
> > 
> Gemini contents:> 
> > 
> ```ts> 
> "contents": [> 
>       {> 
>         "role": "user",> 
>         "parts": [> 
>           {> 
>             "text": "test"> 
>           }> 
>         ]> 
>       },> 
>       {> 
>         "role": "model",> 
>         "parts": [> 
>           {> 
>             "text": "Understood. I'm ready to help with your questions.\n"> 
>           }> 
>         ]> 
>       },> 
>       {> 
>         "role": "user",> 
>         "parts": []    <----- causing the error> 
>       },> 
>       {> 
>         "role": "user",> 
>         "parts": [> 
>           {> 
>             "text": "test"> 
>           }> 
>         ]> 
>       }> 
>     ],> 
> ``` 

 _Originally posted by @trevorpfiz in [#4301](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/4301#issuecomment-2578626408)_

linked_prs.title: fix (ai/core): handle empty tool invocation array in convertToCoreMessages

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves message conversion errors related to LLM provider integration (Gemini), tool invocation (empty tool messages), and memory/content handling in an agent system. It directly references agent-specific components and LLM provider requirements, fitting the agent issue taxonomy.
